snippet.title: Fourleaf Fields - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Fourleaf Fields announcement trailer for the upcoming cozy farming life sim developed by Behemutt, creators of 2023's Nova Lands. Step into the colorful world and check out gameplay from Fourleaf Fields in this trailer. In Fourleaf Fields, players are bug-sized and live among towering plants, friendly insects, and secrets of a tiny world that feels surprisingly big. Fourleaf Fields will be available on PC.
